prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual transparent 2D game character sprite atlas, NOT a concept poster.
Reference roles: image1 is the approved pixel-art Nathan design and visual style. Images2 and3 are face likeness reference photos of the SAME adult man; image4 is his body proportions/tattoos. Preserve THIS man's face, short light-brown/dark-blond side-swept hair, full long brown beard with some lighter strands, broad full cheeks, specific brown eyes and broad nose. He is 195cm tall and140kg, a massive heavy adult man with broad shoulders, thick limbs and natural heavy belly, not a shredded bodybuilder. Black short sleeve t-shirt, dark charcoal cargo trousers, black trainers, forearm tattoos. Match approved pixel design closely.

Create ONE sprite sheet, landscape 1536 by1024 pixels, composed of EXACTLY3 columns and2 rows of equally sized512 by512 cells. Truly transparent alpha background, absolutely no solid backdrop, no checkerboard printed into image, no shadows outside sprites, no labels, no text, no grid. Only SIX separate complete character sprites. Each cell contains ONE Nathan, all facing RIGHT (towards viewer's right) in a consistent slight three-quarter side view. Maintain exact same identity/clothes, body scale and pixel rendering in every pose. Each figure's feet touch a consistent baseline 465px from its cell top; top of head approx65px from cell top. All limbs/boots/hands remain fully within their cell with at least28px clear margin. Center torso around cell center. Do not overlap cells.

Frame order left-to-right:
TOP LEFT: idle boxing/brawler stance, fists ready, feet planted.
TOP MIDDLE: walking step1 towards right, right leg forward left leg back, arms counter-swing in guard.
TOP RIGHT: walking step2 towards right, left leg forward right leg back, inverse of frame2.
BOTTOM LEFT: straight rightward power punch, arm extended horizontally to right, other hand guards, planted feet.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: powerful rightward front kick, kicking leg extended to right at waist height, other leg firmly planted; use compact pose inside cell.
BOTTOM RIGHT: brief recoiling hurt pose leaning torso back towards left, guard raised, both feet visible.

Art style: beautiful expertly crafted 32bit arcade beat-em-up PIXEL ART, clean coherent pixel clusters, dark selective outlines, discrete shaded planes, pixelated beard and face with recognizable likeness, readable small-scale silhouette. No smooth 3D rendering, no soft painted gradients, no cartoon baby/chibi head. Keep the bearded face visible in all poses. Production sprite sheet framing, clean transparent silhouettes.
